write: Create or overwrite an authorized workspace file.
edit: Replace exact text in an authorized workspace file.
bash: Run a shell command; commands may change files.
powershell: Run a PowerShell command; commands may change files.
grep: Search text in authorized workspace files.
find: Find authorized workspace files by pattern.
rp_call: Invoke a module workflow available to this node; read returned documents when needed.
rp_task_next: After finishing the current task stage, request the next stage. Call it alone.
rp_roll: Roll dice; the same key and arguments replay one logical roll.
rp_data_query: Query authorized indexed RP data through a named view.
rp_data_get: Read one authorized RP data record through a named view.
rp_data_resolve: Resolve a name or alias in authorized RP data collections.
rp_team_control: Control the current team discussion phase.
rp_team_handoff: Explicitly hand the floor to another equal collaboration member. Call alone after finishing your speech and tools.
rp_files: List authorized node documents or count text in a file.
rp_deliver: Deliver your owned working document by output ID and relative path; validation preserves its original contents.
rp_node_complete: After all task stages, required calls and valid deliveries, call alone to finish the node.
